summary: Mandatory annual roadworthiness testing for taxis, auto-rickshaws, buses, and commercial freight trucks.

steps.title: Pre-inspection mechanical maintenance
steps.description: Check speed governor calibration, retro-reflective tape visibility, emergency panic buttons, and brake pads.

steps.title: Book fitness test slot on Vahan
steps.description: Pay fitness test fee online and schedule slot at automated testing station.

steps.title: Automated lane inspection
steps.description: Automated rollers and sensors inspect roller brake force, side-slip, suspension play, headlamp beam alignment, and emission.

steps.title: Speed governor & vehicle tracking check
steps.description: Inspectors verify operational status of AIS-140 GPS tracking unit and panic buttons.

steps.title: Grant of Fitness Certificate
steps.description: Receive Form 38 Certificate of Fitness and windshield validity sticker valid for 1 or 2 years.
